title: Kiroween 2026
description: Kiro's annual online Halloween-themed hackathon on Devpost. Build a new working software application with Kiro (IDE, CLI, Web or Kiro Crew) in one of four categories: Resurrection, Frankenstein, Skeleton Crew or Costume Contest. $100,000 in cash prizes.
reward: $100,000 in prizes, paid in cash: $30,000 first, $20,000 second, $10,000 third, $5,000 per category winner, plus bonus prizes such as $10,000 Best Startup Project
summary: $100,000 in prizes · closes Dec 4, 2:00 PM PT

rules: Submit on Devpost by Friday, December 4, 2026 at 2:00 PM Pacific Time.
Only new projects are eligible: build during the Submission Period (October 30 to December 4, 2026). Projects started before October 30, including Kiroween 2025 projects, are not eligible.
You may use standard frameworks, libraries and starter templates, but must disclose any other pre-existing code or work.
Build a working software application that uses Kiro (IDE, CLI, Web and/or Kiro Crew) in one category: Resurrection, Frankenstein, Skeleton Crew or Costume Contest.
The public GitHub repo (not GitLab or Bitbucket) must hold all source code, carry a visible open source license, and include the /.kiro directory at the root. Do not gitignore /.kiro.
Teams can have up to three members. Entrants must be above the legal age of majority; some countries are excluded (see the official rules).
An eligible project can win one Overall Prize or one Category Prize, not both, plus any number of Bonus Prizes.
Request 4,000 free Kiro credits on the Resources tab by December 1 at 12:00 PM PT.
Winners are announced on or around February 3, 2027.
